title: How Much Longer?
can_do: 在车里询问剩余时间，用熟悉的路标确认回答，并选择接下来唱的歌。
trigger: Dad names Grandma's as their destination, and Child wants to understand the remaining wait.
stretch_response: Will we get there after the bridge?
repair_response: I mean, how long until Grandma's house?
setting: A continuous conversation in the family car; Dad is belted and watches the road, and Child stays in his fitted rear-seat child restraint.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: We're on our way to Grandma's.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: About five minutes. That's two songs.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Will we get there after the bridge?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Which song would you like next?

replay_cards.title: Time, not distance
replay_cards.setting: A seated pretend car trip at home
replay_cards.change: Dad answers with distance when Child wants a time estimate
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks, "Where are we going?" Dad names Grandma's. Child asks, "How much longer?" Dad gives the distance, so Child clarifies, "I mean, how long until Grandma's house?" Dad gives a short truthful time estimate. Child accepts it and chooses a quiet song while both remain seated.

replay_cards.title: Waiting for the bus
replay_cards.setting: A calm pretend bus stop at home with Mom
replay_cards.change: The bus has not arrived, and Child still needs his jacket
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks, "How much longer until the bus comes?" Mom says about five minutes. Child answers, "I'm ready, but I still need my jacket." Mom passes his jacket; he puts it on and waits beside her. They do not step into a road or board a moving vehicle.

parent_support: Give a truthful short estimate; two familiar songs are only an approximate way to picture five minutes. Answer the landmark check without promising an exact arrival second.

Dad stays belted with eyes on the road and hands on the wheel. Child stays seated in his correctly fitted restraint. Choosing a song needs no screen, reaching, unbuckling or turn toward the back seat.
Keep the three parts continuous. They agree on the next song before the bridge or arrival; no five-minute time jump or extra sung lyrics belongs inside the demo.
